LanguageData.HKP_Research_ConstableGear.label: HKP constable gear
LanguageData.HKP_Research_ConstableGear.description: Craft everyday Hong Kong Police duty wear: uniform shirts, windbreaker, duty belt, red whistle lanyard, radio and body-worn camera, reflective armband, plus peaked caps, the patrol cap and the constable beret.
LanguageData.HKP_Research_EUGear.label: HKP Emergency Unit gear
LanguageData.HKP_Research_EUGear.description: Craft protective gear used by the Emergency Unit (EU): ballistic vest, tactical trousers and the light tactical helmet.
LanguageData.HKP_Research_PTUGear.label: HKP Police Tactical Unit gear
LanguageData.HKP_Research_PTUGear.description: Craft Police Tactical Unit (PTU) gear: PTU tactical vest, PTU beret, riot helmet, riot shield and the Senior Police Constable service jacket.
LanguageData.HKP_Research_ServiceWeapons.label: HKP service weapons
LanguageData.HKP_Research_ServiceWeapons.description: Craft basic Hong Kong Police weapons: the Smith & Wesson Model 10 .38 revolver and the riot baton.
LanguageData.HKP_Research_EUWeapons.label: HKP Emergency Unit firearms
LanguageData.HKP_Research_EUWeapons.description: Craft Emergency Unit (EU) firearms: the CS/LP5 police pistol, the Remington 870 police shotgun and the Remington 870 beanbag shotgun.
LanguageData.HKP_Research_PTUWeapons.label: HKP Police Tactical Unit firearms
LanguageData.HKP_Research_PTUWeapons.description: Craft Police Tactical Unit (PTU) and tactical firearms: the CS/LS7 submachine gun, the M16A2 rifle and the Federal M201-Z tear gas launcher.
